Game Overview

Sword Hunter puts players into a fighting experience centered on engage in relentless 2D combat as a sword-wielding heroine on a quest for justice. Swiftly vanquish waves of foes, upgrade your skills, and strategize with fluid controls. Enjoy captivating visuals and a tactical edge as you conquer progressively challenging enemy battles to fulfill your heroic destiny.

How to Play

Playing Sword Hunter comes down to a simple loop. Engage in relentless 2D combat as a sword-wielding heroine on a quest for justice. Swiftly vanquish waves of foes, upgrade your skills, and strategize with fluid controls. Enjoy captivating visuals and a tactical edge as you conquer progressively challenging enemy battles to fulfill your heroic destiny.
